title: The Rye From Lawrenceburg
subtitle: One Indiana distillery and the American rye revival
description: The story of the Lawrenceburg, Indiana distillery: George Ross's Rossville distillery of 1847, the Seagram years and the 95% rye made to flavour blends, a near-closure, and the rye revival that took its whiskey out under one label after another. Four pours, each from the same distillery in different hands.
tags: rye, american whiskey, history, distilleries, sourcing, blending

pours.name: Bulleit 95 Rye
pours.origin: Distilled in Lawrenceburg, Indiana; bottled by Bulleit in Kentucky
pours.style: Straight rye whiskey, 95% rye, 5% malted barley
pours.notes: The opener, poured at the start while the history is told. Made to Bulleit's specification on the Lawrenceburg 95% rye recipe.

pours.name: George Dickel Rye
pours.origin: Distilled in Lawrenceburg, Indiana; George Dickel (Diageo)
pours.style: Rye whiskey, 95% rye, 5% malted barley, chill and sugar-maple charcoal filtered
pours.notes: The same recipe with a step from Dickel's Tennessee tradition. Taste it next to glass 1 and ask what the charcoal does.

pours.name: Templeton Straight Rye
pours.origin: Distilled in Lawrenceburg, Indiana; bottled by Templeton in Templeton, Iowa
pours.style: Straight rye whiskey, 95% rye, 5% malted barley, at least 4 years
pours.notes: A brand built on an Iowa town's Prohibition legend, whose label changed in 2015 and which now distils its own rye in Iowa. Check the back label: this bottle is selected from sourced stock.

pours.name: Rossville Union Straight Rye
pours.origin: MGP Distillery (called Ross & Squibb 2021–2026), Lawrenceburg, Indiana
pours.style: Straight rye whiskey, a blend of the distillery's 95% and 51% rye recipes, at least 4 years
pours.notes: The distillery under its own name, launched in 2018 and named after George Ross's Rossville distillery of 1847.
